items.description: The disruptions over the weekend at several major European airports were caused by a ransomware attack targeting the check-in and boarding systems. [...]

items.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Target Europe With New Malware
items.description: "Nimbus Manticore" is back at it, this time with improved variants of its flagship malware and targets that are outside its usual focus area.
